fixes.old:
the three `Layout` alignment cops that
used to live in `Lint`.
fixes.new:
the three `Layout` alignment cops, two of
which used to live in `Lint`.
evidence: grep -n "Severity:" config/default.yml => the only Layout cops with Severity are Layout/BeginEndAlignment (498), Layout/DefEndAlignment (610), Layout/EndAlignment (802)
config/obsoletion.yml:21 "Lint/DefEndAlignment: Layout/DefEndAlignment", :23 "Lint/EndAlignment: Layout/EndAlignment"; nothing for BeginEndAlignment
fixes.note: Of the three Layout alignment cops with Severity: warning, only DefEndAlignment and EndAlignment were renamed from Lint; BeginEndAlignment was added as a new Layout cop in 0.91, so "two of which" is correct.

fixes.new: the PR template asks for it.
evidence: grep -n -i changelog .github/workflows/*.yml => no output (workflows run only internal_investigation, spec, ascii_spec, prism_spec, documentation_syntax_check)
spec/project_spec.rb:339-389 only checks the format of changelog/*.md files that already exist, not that a PR adds one
Rakefile:7-8 changelog:check_clean runs only before a release; tasks/check_commit.rake does not check the changelog
.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md "* [ ] Added an entry (file) to the [changelog folder]... if the new code introduces user-observable changes."
fixes.note: Nothing in CI checks that a changelog entry is present (only the format of existing entries), while the PR template does have a checkbox asking for one, so the new reason is true and the old one is not.
